item.title: Undeclared Active Ingredients Found in OTC Skin Products
item.description: One-third of over-the-counter skin products sold online contain undeclared pharmacologically active ingredients, according to a new report.

item.title: Online Sports Betting Tied to Increased Depression and Anxiety Treatment
item.description: In states that legalized online sports betting, more people are receiving treatment for depression and anxiety.

item.title: Europe Broadens Cardiac Rehabilitation Guidelines
item.description: The first ESC cardiac rehab guidelines expand indications, support telerehabilitation, and recommend earlier referral after major cardiovascular events.

item.title: Specific Risk Factors Linked to Epinephrine Use in Preschool OIT
item.description: Among preschool children receiving oral immunotherapy for food allergies, reactions requiring epinephrine are rare, with most being mild to moderate.
